player_prompt.intro:
Yu i pley Blackjack wantaim dila.
Go bilong yu em i kisim skor 21 o karim olgeta na i no go pas.
Long taim bilong yu, yu chusim '[Hit]' long pulim moa kard o '[Stand]' long holim.
J/Q/K = 10 poin; A = 11 o 1, wanem i gut moa.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Akshan i no gud. Yu usim '[Hit]' o '[Stand]'.

game_message.hand_result: Han {hand_number}: yu {outcome}. Skor bilong yu i go daun long {player_score}, Dila i go daun long {dealer_score}.
game_message.all_complete:
=== All {num_hands} hands complete ===
Wins: {wins}, Losses: {losses}, Draws: {draws}

outcome.game_over: Gem i pinis. Skor bilong taim i go daun: Dila: {losses}, Yu: {wins}, Dro: {draws}
